national_news.title: Ladakh Begins Self-Enumeration Phase for Census 2027
bullets: Ladakh has become the first Union Territory in India to launch the self-enumeration phase (August 17–31) for Census 2027.
Due to harsh winter conditions and difficult terrain, the region will follow a special reference date of October 1.
The digital census exercise involves the creation of 637 Enumeration Blocks to ensure comprehensive regional coverage.

national_news.title: India Hosts 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting in New Delhi
bullets: India is hosting the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting in New Delhi under its 2026 BRICS Chairship theme: 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
The meeting is presided over by Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Bhupender Yadav.
Identified four key priority areas: Promoting Sustainable Lifestyles, Afforestation & Forest Fire Management, Circular Economy, and Climate Adaptation.

national_news.title: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh Confers National Anubhav Awards 2026
bullets: MoS Dr. Jitendra Singh conferred the National Anubhav Awards 2026 to 15 awardees for their contributions to nation-building and governance reform.
The event included the release of the Handbook on Pension Mitra and guidelines for the Digital Life Certificate (DLC) Campaign-Five.
The 'Anubhav' platform enables retiring Central Government, PSB, and CPSE employees to submit write-ups on significant workplace achievements.

national_news.title: BWF Badminton World Championships Begins in New Delhi
bullets: The BWF Badminton World Championships commenced at the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium in New Delhi.
Former World Champion PV Sindhu leads the Indian campaign in the Women's Singles category.
Top Indian Men's Doubles pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty advanced to the second round after receiving a first-round bye.

national_news.title: India Draws 2-2 Against China in FIH Women’s Hockey World Cup Opener
bullets: India played out a 2-2 draw against China in their opening Pool D group-stage match of the FIH Women’s Hockey World Cup at Amstelveen, Netherlands.
Navneet gave India an early lead in the 8th minute, while Deepika scored the second goal from a penalty corner in the 25th minute.
India is placed in Pool D alongside China, England, and South Africa.

national_news.title: Magnus Carlsen Retains Esports World Cup Chess Title
bullets: World No. 1 Magnus Carlsen won the Esports World Cup chess title for the second consecutive year in Paris, France.
Carlsen defeated Belarusian Grandmaster Denis Lazavik 2-0 in the finals and remained undefeated throughout the tournament.
American Grandmaster Hikaru Nakamura secured the third position in the tournament.

national_news.title: DRI Uncovers ₹2,500 Crore SAFTA Evasion in Areca Nut Imports
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) dismantled a major network fraudulently claiming duty benefits under the South Asian Free Trade Area (SAFTA) agreement.
Areca nuts originating from Indonesia, Thailand, and Malaysia were falsely declared as Bangladeshi origin to evade the standard 100% Basic Customs Duty (BCD).
The multi-state investigation revealed a potential revenue loss of over ₹2,500 crore to the exchequer and led to the arrest of nine persons.

national_news.title: DRI Busts Areca Nut Import Syndicate Misusing SAFTA Agreement
bullets: DRI under the Union Ministry of Finance exposed a syndicate routing South-East Asian areca nuts through Export Processing Zones in Bangladesh.
The syndicate fraudulently obtained Certificates of Origin from Bangladeshi authorities to claim 100% customs duty exemptions meant for SAFTA member nations.
The operation prevented a potential exchequer loss of ₹2,500 crore and resulted in the suspension of offending Customs Broker licenses.

national_news.title: DRI Uncovers Rs 2,500 Crore Customs Duty Fraud Involving SAFTA Misuse
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) dismantled a syndicate involved in fraudulently importing Southeast Asian areca nuts into India.
Importers falsely declared Bangladesh as the country of origin to evade 100% Basic Customs Duty by claiming exemptions under SAFTA Rules of Origin.
The fraud resulted in an estimated revenue loss of over Rs 2,500 crore to the exchequer, leading to nine arrests.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Construct 100 Modern Bus Stands Across State
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister announced plans to construct over 100 modern and state-of-the-art bus stands to strengthen road transport.
The initiative aims to improve urban infrastructure and accelerate industrial development in the state.
The announcement was made in Jhajha, Jamui district, during the unveiling of a statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.

bihar_news.title: Railway Ministry Sanctions ₹2,627 Crore Sherghati-Kajree Rail Line
bullets: The Railway Ministry approved the 107.89-km broad-gauge railway project connecting Sherghati (Gaya, Bihar) with Kajree (Palamu, Jharkhand).
The total estimated cost of the project is ₹2,627.29 crore, executed by the East Central Railway (ECR) zone.
Civil engineering works received the major allocation of ₹2,399.38 crore, alongside allocations for S&T and electrical works.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Issues Directives Against Unnecessary Patient Referrals in Government Hospitals
bullets: Bihar CM issued a warning to government doctors against transferring patients to higher centers when local treatment facilities exist.
The state government is expanding health infrastructure and surgical capabilities across district hospitals to enable localized care.
The directive aims to enhance healthcare accessibility and curb overloading of tertiary care referral hospitals.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Fast-Track Air Infrastructure in Six Districts
bullets: Bihar CM directed officials to expedite the development of aviation facilities across six designated districts in the state.
The project focuses on enhancing regional air connectivity and regional economic development.
The state is actively strengthening existing airstrips and airport infrastructure to support civil aviation.

bihar_news.title: 7.7 MW Solar Power Project Commissioned in Gaya Under PM-KUSUM
bullets: A 7.7 MW ground-mounted solar power plant was commissioned in Gaya, Bihar, under the PM-KUSUM scheme.
Hoymiles deployed 20 units of 350 kW high-efficiency string inverters (HINV350HX-G2) for the project.
Executed by Naw Dharam Energy as EPC partner, the solar project feeds clean renewable energy into the local grid.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Resume Mining Operations Post-October 15
bullets: Bihar announced the planned resumption of state mining activities starting after October 15.
Tender processes for 28 mineral blocks are currently underway, with over 30 blocks slated for allocation by September end.
Focus is directed toward critical and strategic minerals necessary for EV, electronics, and renewable energy sectors.

bihar_news.title: Ministry of Mines Holds Patna Roadshow for 8th Tranche Critical Mineral Auctions
bullets: Union Ministry of Mines organized a roadshow in Patna for the 8th tranche of critical and strategic mineral block auctions.
The program included a specialized workshop on the National Mineral Exploration and Development Trust (NMEDT) scheme.
Chaired by Union Minister of State Satish Chandra Dubey along with officials from GSI, MECL, and the Bihar state government.

bihar_news.title: Patna Hosts NMEDT Workshop and Strategic Mineral Auction Program
bullets: Ministry of Mines conducted a joint workshop with Bihar's State Mines Minister Dr. Pramod Kumar in Patna.
The session showcased investment opportunities in critical and strategic mineral blocks across the state.
Promoted participation under the National Mineral Exploration and Development Trust (NMEDT) Framework.

bihar_news.title: Ministry of Mines Roadshow Highlights Bihar's Critical Mineral Potential
bullets: A national roadshow was conducted in Patna to engage investors in critical mineral block auctions.
Detailed strategies were presented for the exploration and development of high-tech and strategic minerals in India.
Aims to foster sustainable mining practices and regional economic growth in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: CEC Highlights Record Voter Turnout Following Special Intensive Revision in Bihar
bullets: Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar stated that the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Bihar was conducted successfully for the first time.
The mammoth three-month SIR exercise led to the removal of nearly 70 lakh invalid or duplicate names from the state's electoral rolls.
The updated electoral roll resulted in record voter turnout during the Bihar assembly elections, exceeding participation rates seen in advanced democracies like the US, UK, and France.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Targets ₹5 Lakh Crore Investment and 1 Crore Jobs by 2030
bullets: The Bihar government has set a target of attracting ₹5 lakh crore in industrial investments by November.
Key initiatives include launching new industrial policies and educational reforms.
The state announced plans to generate employment opportunities for 1 crore youth by 2030.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Build New Airports and Helipads to Boost Infrastructure and Tourism
bullets: Bihar plans to construct new airports and helipads to expand air connectivity across the state.
The project aims to boost tourism, trade, industry, investment, and local employment.
The state government will coordinate with the Union Ministry of Civil Aviation for project execution.
